question_en:
A high school physics laboratory needs to prepare a spectral line demonstration using all the bandpass filters listed in the figure. Please answer:

Calculate the closed interval of the full width at half maximum (FWHM) bandwidth for each model based on its official center wavelength and FWHM. What is the minimum number of filters required so that the four demonstration lines at 313, 365, 405, and 425 nm all fall within the closed FWHM bandwidth interval of at least one selected filter? Which selected filter covers each of the four spectral lines? Which filters are not selected, and are there any spectral lines that cannot be covered? Please provide a complete itemized table containing "Position in Figure, Model, Center Wavelength, FWHM, Closed FWHM Bandwidth Interval, Selected (Yes/No)", and state the count of the minimum covering set.

If multiple solutions with the same minimum number of filters exist, sequentially select the filters with lower center wavelengths. Every item in the figure must be included in the itemized table.

The answer must include the complete itemized table described above, followed by the minimum covering set and its count, the correspondence between the four spectral lines and the selected filters, the list of unselected filters, and any spectral lines that cannot be covered.
